ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approx. 85:15 white-to-black pixel ratio across visible ventral surface; dominant high-intensity white field with low-intensity black margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field; irregular black contiguous banding along the trailing edge and distal tips; concentrated dark pixel clusters in the lower right lobe area and proximal to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation; approximately 65-degree interior pixel angle; high-depth penetration relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration; high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire visible boundary, with larger amplitude deviations near the notch and distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature fitted to the trailing edge from the notch extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters on the terminal distal tips, indicating colonial scarring or barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal dark linear disruption visible on the lower right lobe; smaller vertical linear marks observed in the central-left ventral region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable dark organic protrusions/growths at the terminal points of both distal tips; irregular black pigmentation patches along the trailing edge margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Single prominent vertical dark pixel line located centrally, immediately inferior to the median notch.
